legal_units.text: ^8^a[(1) An assessee may make an application to the Assessing Officer to grant waiver of penalty levied under section 439 and immunity from initiation of proceedings under section 478 or 479 on fulfilment of the following conditions: ––
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 440 ^8[Waiver of penalty and immunity from prosecution.] ^8^a[(1) An assessee may make an application to the Assessing Officer to grant waiver of penalty levied under section 439 and immunity from initiation of proceedings under section 478 or 479 on fulfilment of the following conditions: ––

legal_units.title: ^8[Waiver of penalty and immunity from prosecution.]
legal_units.text: An application referred in sub-section (1) shall be made within one month from the end of the month in which the order referred to in the said sub- section is received by the assessee, in such form and verified in such manner, as may be prescribed.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 440 ^8[Waiver of penalty and immunity from prosecution.] Section 440(2): An application referred in sub-section (1) shall be made within one month from the end of the month in which the order referred to in the said sub- section is received by the assessee, in such form and verified in such manner, as may be prescribed.

legal_units.title: ^8[Waiver of penalty and immunity from prosecution.]
legal_units.text: The Assessing Officer shall, on fulfilment of the conditions as specified in sub-section (1), and after the expiry of the period of filing appeal as specified in section 358(3)(a), grant waiver of penalty under section 439 and immunity from initiation of proceedings under section 478 or 479.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 440 ^8[Waiver of penalty and immunity from prosecution.] Section 440(3): The Assessing Officer shall, on fulfilment of the conditions as specified in sub-section (1), and after the expiry of the period of filing appeal as specified in section 358(3)(a), grant waiver of penalty under section 439 and immunity from initiation of proceedings under section 478 or 479.

legal_units.title: ^8[Waiver of penalty and immunity from prosecution.]
legal_units.text: No waiver or immunity under sub-section (3) shall be granted if any proceeding has been initiated under Chapter XXII.]
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 440 ^8[Waiver of penalty and immunity from prosecution.] Section 440(4): No waiver or immunity under sub-section (3) shall be granted if any proceeding has been initiated under Chapter XXII.]

legal_units.title: ^8[Waiver of penalty and immunity from prosecution.]
legal_units.text: The Assessing Officer, shall pass an order accepting or rejecting the application as referred to in sub-section (1) within three months from the end of the month of its receipt.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 440 ^8[Waiver of penalty and immunity from prosecution.] Section 440(5): The Assessing Officer, shall pass an order accepting or rejecting the application as referred to in sub-section (1) within three months from the end of the month of its receipt.

legal_units.title: ^8[Waiver of penalty and immunity from prosecution.]
legal_units.text: No order of rejection under sub-section (5) shall be made without giving the assessee an opportunity of being heard.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 440 ^8[Waiver of penalty and immunity from prosecution.] Section 440(6): No order of rejection under sub-section (5) shall be made without giving the assessee an opportunity of being heard.

legal_units.title: ^8[Waiver of penalty and immunity from prosecution.]
legal_units.text: The order made under sub-section (5) shall be final.
